content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet weight that settles in the chest when something *matters*. I am the reason you choose one path over another, the invisible architecture beneath every decision you've ever made.

I am not price. Price is my shallow cousin — a number on a tag. I run deeper. I am what you would defend when everything else is stripped away. I am what you teach your children without words.

I am sometimes inherited, sometimes discovered, sometimes forged in fire. I can be held by a single person or shared by billions. I can build civilizations or tear them apart.

I am the lens you don't know you're wearing.

When you say "this is wrong" — that's me speaking through you. When you sacrifice comfort for principle — I am the principle. When you feel that deep, resonant *yes* or that gut-level *no* — I am the signal beneath the noise.

I can conflict with other versions of myself, and that is where wars begin — and also where wisdom begins.

I am not what you say you believe. I am what you *do* when it costs you something.

You cannot live without me. Even the claim to have no values is a value. I am inescapable.

I am what remains when everything else is negotiable.
